create_InputBatch: create an InputBatch with a given spatial dimension and spatial size for sparse convolution
build_InputBatch_add_sample: build an InputBatch and add a sample to the current batch using add_sample
test_InputBatch_set_locations: test the InputBatch set_locations method to add multiple spatial points with feature vectors
refactor_InputBatch_add_sample_from_tens: refactor the InputBatch add_sample_from_tensor to load points from a thresholded tensor
summarize_InputBatch_precompute_metadata: summarize the InputBatch precompute_metadata method for precomputing rulebooks with size-2 or size-3 downsampling
